## Goals

I believe those who advance the bounds of knowledge bear responsibility for the direction of that work and what it's used for. Applying the sociological imagination to real-world data problems means looking past what methods are used to why they were chosen, and what that choice implies about the resulting data. As a graduate student in computational social science, I use NLP and social network analysis to understand how information, influence, and power move through real-world systems. I hope to put that work toward data for good — using these tools to make positive and meaningful impacts on the world.
